convert_primitive_var_types: convert primitive variable types in a list of instructions by mapping int types to c_uint64
replace_load_consts: replace LOAD_CONST opcodes with ConstVar objects and propagate them to source variables in instructions
replace_arg_loads: replace LOAD_FAST opcodes for function arguments with ArgVar objects using provided argument types
insert_fast_vars: insert FastVar objects for LOAD_FAST and STORE_FAST opcodes in a list of instructions
replace_fast_stores: replace destination variables with stored FastVar mappings and filter non-Var stores from instructions
